summary: STRK is down about 12% in 24h and roughly 40-46% on the week, as the 127M-token unlock on 15 Oct works through. StarkWare's non-binding poll (open until 22 Oct) shows 99.95% support for researching an independent post-quantum L1, but any move is years away, and posts say supply is still being absorbed. Mildly bearish.
catalyst_note: 127M STRK unlock on 15 Oct (negative supply event); non-binding L1 research poll runs 15-22 Oct (small positive)
